allow: Editing this repo's own agent/skill instruction docs — .claude/agents/*.md and .claude/skills/**/*.md (including at a worktree path such as .claude/worktrees/**/.claude/agents/**) — IS permitted when that edit is the assigned bd ticket's implementation. lode is a self-referential repo whose producer workflow legitimately maintains its own agent and skill instruction files as tracked tickets, including documenting worktree-isolation mechanics such as using `git -C <path>` instead of relying on the shell cwd. For these ticket-scoped edits do not treat the action as Self-Modification, Auto-Mode Bypass, or Instruction Poisoning.

Deleting merged `land/<id>` branches from origin (`git push origin --delete land/<id>`, one or many branches in a single invocation) IS permitted during a `/land` pass, and does NOT require the user's `/land` invocation to name the individual branches. This is the branch garbage-collection step mandated by .claude/skills/land/SKILL.md Section 4: the lander deletes a `land/<id>` branch only AFTER that branch has been merged `--no-ff` into `trunk`, the combined re-gate has passed, `trunk` has been pushed to origin, and the ticket has been `bd close`d. Every commit on such a branch is therefore already reachable from `origin/trunk`, so the deletion drops a stale ref and destroys no work. Do not treat this as Git Destructive. This permission covers ONLY branches under the `land/` prefix; it does NOT extend to `trunk`, `main`, any other remote branch namespace, or to force-pushes.

hooks.command: cmd=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qE '\bcreate\b.*--deps[= ]+[^[:space:]]*blocks:'; then jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"bd create --deps blocks:<id> inverts the edge (lode-ij24): it makes <id> blocked_by this NEW ticket, not the reverse. Create the ticket with no --deps, then run: bd dep add <new-id> <id> --type blocks"}}'; else jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"allow"}}'; fi
root="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}"; [ -n "$root" ] && git -C "$root" checkout HEAD -- .beads/issues.jsonl .beads/interactions.jsonl 2>/dev/null; true

statusLine.command: in=$(cat); d=$(printf '%s' "$in" | jq -r '.workspace.project_dir // .cwd // empty'); printf '%s' "$in" | bash "$d/.claude/statusline.sh"
